_readme: Challenge numbers (PRD 11.1, ADR-0004). Each challenge names a base tier from tiers.json and replaces some of its fields under `profile`, with the same names and bounds as tiers.json. `mutators` names rule variants: `endless` means no resurrection ship, and the run is scored by the jumps the fleet held. `slow-ftl` makes every cycle 66 seconds (arriving 5, spool the last 8). `fleetRepairOfMissing` may be a list by cycle, like the swarm ramps: Endless uses it so Tyrol tires and every run ends. Names, blurbs, and verdicts live in src/content/challenges.json under the same id. Keep ids stable: share links carry them. `npm run sim` reports every challenge.

weekly._readme: The weekly challenge's pool (PRD 11.1). Each week takes the base tier, one swarm variant, and one fleet variant, picked from the ISO week. A swarm variant may set only swarm and heavy fields, a fleet variant only fleetCycleDamageCap and fleetRepairOfMissing. The first of each list is the tier's own numbers, and a week never pairs those two (that would be Story mode). Every pair must be one `npm run sim` has reported: keep the hunter bot winning at least a quarter of the time. Changing this pool changes past weeks' rules too; shared links carry the game version, so an old result reads as old.
